faqData.q: What is Galileo & Duke's core focus and expertise?
faqData.a: Galileo & Duke is a design and development studio founded by Moksh and Varul. We build web experiences that go beyond the template — cinematic motion, scroll-driven storytelling, and bespoke engineering. We specialize in React Three Fiber, WebGL spatial interfaces, GSAP animation systems, and performance-optimized modern web architecture.

faqData.q: What types of projects do you partner on?
faqData.a: We partner with ambitious brands, forward-thinking startups, and creative agencies seeking flagship web experiences — ranging from interactive 3D product launches, scroll-scrubbed video narratives, and custom design systems to complete digital brand transformations.

faqData.q: What is your typical production tech stack?
faqData.a: Our production stack pairs Next.js, React, and TypeScript with cutting-edge visual libraries including React Three Fiber, Three.js, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS. We engineer with physics-based interaction models while ensuring ultra-fast load speeds, robust SEO, and fluid 60fps performance across all devices.

faqData.q: How do Moksh and Varul collaborate with clients?
faqData.a: Every project is led directly by our co-founders. Moksh spearheads creative direction, visual prototyping, and frontend motion engineering. Varul directs brand strategy, client alignment, and technical architecture. This direct access ensures high agility, zero translation loss, and uncompromising craft.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at hello@galileoduke.com. Moksh and Varul review all project inquiries personally within 24 hours to explore collaboration fit.
